body.statement: Let \(\gamma(v)\) be the gap from \(\max_av_a\) to the largest nonmaximal coordinate, with \(\gamma(v)=\infty\) if every coordinate ties. Then \(\|q_{c,b}(v)-q_{0,b}(v)\|_1\le2\beta^{-1}\exp\{-\gamma(v)/c\}\) and \(|\ell_{c,b}(u,z)-\ell_{0,b}(u,z)|\le2c\log(1/\beta)+2\|z\|_\infty\beta^{-1}\exp\{-\gamma(u+z)/c\}\). Moreover, uniformly in \(h\in\mathcal H\) and \(V\in\mathcal K_V\), the probability that any pair of augmented action coordinates of \(R(h+Z_V)\) lies within \(a>0\) is at most \(JK(K-1)a/\sqrt{2\pi v_{\min}}\).
body.justification: This lemma handles exact and multiway ties without imposing a unique best action.
body.gap: Whitehouse et al. use uniform weights over exact maximizers for a scalar optimal-value influence function; the present endpoint instead renormalizes the benchmark lottery and requires a uniform multiaction slab bound.
body.consumer: It controls the discontinuous state geometry in the path coupling and certifies off-grid behavior near the hard rule.
